reason: Confirmed on Ubuntu 24.04.5 x86_64 using installed uv 0.13.0 and Python 3.12.15. With UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR, UV_PYTHON_BIN_DIR, and UV_CACHE_DIR isolated under /tmp and configuration disabled, ran `uv python install 3.12`, deleted only `cpython-3.12.15-linux-x86_64-gnu/bin/python3.12`, then repeated the install. It exited 0 and reported successful installation, but the executable remained missing. Before and after that install, `uv run --no-project --managed-python --python 3.12 python -c "print('ok')"` exited 2 with `Python interpreter not found`. `uv python install --reinstall 3.12` restored the executable; the same run command then printed `ok`. Updated $RUNNER_TEMP/issue-context/README.md with evidence and test-coverage findings. Windows and the reported uv 0.13.1 were not tested.
